verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।  व्यथयेयुरिमे सेनां देवानामपि सञ्जय।  आहवे ये न्यवर्तन्त वृकोदरमुखा नृपाः॥१॥
संप्रयुक्तः किलैवायं दिष्टैर्भवति पूरुषः।  तस्मिन्नेव च सर्वार्थाः प्रदृश्यन्ते पृथग्विधाः॥२॥
verses.english: Led by Destiny, man surely engages in any action and it is through the decrees of Destiny that his various acts are attended with various results.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घं विप्रोषितः कालमरण्ये जटिलोऽजिनी।  अज्ञातश्चैव लोकस्य विजहार युधिष्ठिरः॥३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: संप्रयुक्तः संबद्धः भवति उत्पद्यते तस्मिन् दिष्ट एव ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: स एव महतीं सेनां समावर्तयदाहवे।  किमन्यद्दैवसंयोगान्मम पुत्रस्य चाभवत्॥४॥
verses.english: Even that very Yudhishthira is now leading this mighty host in battle! What else but evil. can befall my son through this adverse influence of Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: युक्त एव हि भाग्येन ध्रुवमुत्पद्यते नरः।  स तथा कृष्यते तेन न यथा स्वयमिच्छति॥५॥
verses.english: Surely man is born subject to the decrees of Destiny; and so he is compelled by it to do what he does not at all desire.

verses.sanskrit: द्यूतव्यसनमासाद्य क्लेशितो हि युधिष्ठिरः।  स पुनर्भागधेयेन सहायानुपलब्धवान्॥६॥
verses.english: Becoming addicted to the vice of gambling at dice, Yudhishthira reaped great affliction; but now through the agency of Destiny, he has again been united to his supporters.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे केकया लब्धाः काशिकाः कोसलाश्च ये।  चेदयश्चापरे वङ्गा मामेव समुपाश्रिताः॥७॥
verses.english: *Today the Kekayas are rallying to me; the Kausikas, the Kosalas, the Chedis, the Vangas and others are all betaking to me.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी भूयसी तात मम पार्थस्य नो तथा।  इति मामब्रवीत् सूत मन्दो दुर्योधनः पुरा॥८॥
verses.english: All this extensive earth has taken my side, O sire and not that of the sons of Pritha.' 0 Suta, these were the words that were spoken to ine by the wicked Duryodhana before.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सेनासमूहस्य मध्ये द्रोणः सुरक्षितः।  निहतः पार्षतेनाजौ किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥९॥
verses.english: Drona, guarded amidst this host of his warriors, as slain by the son of Prisata in battle; what can it be but there decree of Fate?

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये राज्ञां महाबाहुं सदा युद्धाभिनन्दिनम्।  सर्वास्त्रपारगं द्रोणं कथं मृत्युरुपेयिवान् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Amidst that royal host how could Death approach that mighty-armed Drona who ever delighted in battle and who was accomplished in the use of all sorts of weapons?

verses.sanskrit: समनुप्राप्तकृच्छ्रोऽहं मोहं परममागतः।  भीष्मद्रोणौ हतौ श्रुत्वा नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥११॥
यन्मां क्षत्ताऽब्रवीत्तात प्रपश्यन् पुत्रगृद्धिनम्।  दुर्योधनेन तत् सर्वं प्राप्तं सूत मया सह॥१२॥
verses.english: O Suta, that which the prophetic Khatva said to me, seeing me, infatuated with the affection for my son, O sire, everything of that has now overtaken me and Duryodhana himself.

verses.sanskrit: नृशंसं तु परं तु स्यात्त्यक्त्वा दुर्योधनं यदि।  पुत्रशेषं चिकीर्षेयं कृत्स्नं न मरणं व्रजेत्॥१३॥
verses.english: It would have been very cruel had I saved the rest of my progeny by abandoning Duryodhana, but then the rest could have lived.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि धर्मं परित्यज्य भवत्यर्थपरो नरः।  सोऽस्माच्च हीयते लोकात् क्षुद्रभावं च गच्छति॥१४॥
verses.english: The monarch, that abandoning righteousness, pursues interest, is debarred from the enjoyment of felicity and imbibes meanness.
verses.bhavadeepa: दुर्योधनं त्यक्त्वा यदि पुत्रशेषं चिकीर्षेयं तत्परं केवलं नृशसं स्यात्कृत्स्नं मरणं तु न भवेदित्यन्वयः ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: अद्य चाप्यस्य राष्ट्रस्य हतोत्साहस्य सञ्जय।  अवशेषं न पश्यामि ककुदे मृदिते सति॥१५॥
verses.english: O Sanjaya, today, when the hump of this kingdom has been crushed, I see that nothing will be left of it, as it has lost all energy (by the death of Drona).

verses.sanskrit: कथं स्यादवशेषो हि धुर्ययोरभ्यतीतयोः।  यौ नित्यमुपजीवामः क्षमिणौ पुरुषर्षभौ॥१६॥
व्यक्तमेव च मे शंस यथा युद्धमवर्तत।  केऽयुध्यन् के व्यपाकुर्वन् के क्षुद्राः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥१७॥
verses.english: Relate to me, in detail, as to how that battle raged: who were they that fought, who assaulted (the enemy) and what mean fellows fled, out of terror?

verses.sanskrit: धनञ्जयं च मे शंस यद्यच्चक्रे रथर्षभः। तस्माद्भयं नो भूयिष्ठं भ्रातृव्याच्च वृकोदरात्॥१८॥
verses.english: Tell me also what that foremost of carwarriors, namely, Dhananjaya, did? We are much afraid of him and of his brother, Vrikodara, who is our (implacable) enemy.

verses.sanskrit: यथाऽऽसीच्च निवृत्तेषु पाण्डवेयेषु सञ्जय।  मम सैन्यावशेषस्य सन्निपातः सुदारुणः॥१९॥
verses.english: Tell me, O Sanjaya, of the terrible collusion that took place between the Pandava hosts and the remnant of my army, when the former returned to the charge?

verses.sanskrit: कथं च वो मनस्तात निवृत्तेष्वभवत् तदा।  मामकानां च ये शूराः के कांस्तत्र न्यवारयन्॥२०॥
verses.english: What also, O sire, was the state of your mind when they returned to the attack. What heroes of our army with stood them on the field of battle?
